notifications.name: The pacifier chain belt (Attache sucette)
notifications.danger: The soother holder has openings in which the child could have the fingers trapped. Moreover, the soother holder is too long, it can become wrapped around the neck of the child, causing strangulation. Additionally, the clip device can easily brake, releasing small pieces. A small child may put these in the mouth and choke. The clothing fastener device can also easily disconnect. A small child could also take this small part, put it in the mouth and choke. The product does not comply with the General Product Safety Regulation nor with the European standard EN 12586.

notifications.name: Hairdryer-Foldable
notifications.danger: If the appliance is dropped the back casing of the hair dryer becomes detached from the rest of the appliance, rendering the blades of the fan accessible to the user. This may lead to injuries. Some conductors are held in place by soldering only. With wear and tear over time, the soldering may deteriorate and the conductors may come loose. Consequently, the distance between the live parts and the accessible parts becomes too small, leading to a risk of electric shock. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

notifications.name: Mini Seche Cheveux Professionnel Ionique 2200W
notifications.danger: The button to control ventilation is not properly affixed and may become detached. Small children may put them in the mouth and choke.Furthermore, once the button has detached, live parts are exposed. Additionally, inside the switches and the appliance the electrical wires of the product are not sufficiently insulated. The distance between these wires and accessible parts is insufficient. Moreover, the wires soldering can easily deteriorate. The user can therefore access live parts and receive an electric shock. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.
